senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חשש) [to be pressed, thick,] to be dark.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 34a">Sabb. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 51a:10">51ᵃ</cite> <he>משחָשְׁכָה</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 4:2">ib. IV, 2</cite> <he>משתֶּחְשַׁךְ</he> when it darkens (at nightfall, v. <cite ref="H01837"><he>חֲשֵׁיכָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:19">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>עולם ח׳ בעדו</he> the world around him is dark; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="H01820"><he>חָשׁוּךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:21">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>אל יֶחְשְׁכוּ וכ׳</he> let not our eyes be obscured; a. fr. V. <cite ref="H01820"><he>חָשׁוּךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:1">Sabb. XXIV, 1</cite> <he>מי שה׳ בדרך</he> he who is on the road at nightfall (on Friday).

senses.gloss: to wait for the nightfall, to make preparations to be ready for work on the exit of the Sabbath, v. חֲשִׁיכָה. Ib. XXIII, 3 אין מַחְשִׁיכִין על וכ׳ you must not, during the day, walk to the extreme end of the Sabbath limit to await the night there for the purpose of hiring workmen etc.; אבל מַחְשִׁיךְ הוא וכ׳ but one may do so for the purpose of going at nightfall to watch his field, and then he may also take his fruits home. Ib. להַחְשִׁיךְ עליו to await the night at the Sabbath limit for the purpose of doing it. Ib. 4; a. fr.

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:3">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>חשכים</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 22:29">Prov. XXII, 29</cite>) that is Potifar <he>שה׳ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> whose eyes the Lord darkened etc.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51">Ex. R. s. 51</cite> (ref. to <he>חשכה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 15:12">Gen. XV, 12</cite>) that is Media <he>שהֶחְשִׁיכָה וכ׳</he> who made Israel’s eyes dim (with tears) by her decrees.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 47:1">Pesik. R. s. 47</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 38:2">Job XXXVIII, 2</cite>) <he>הֶחְשַׁכְתָּ וכ׳</he> (not <he>החשב׳</he>) thou hast obscured the council which I held in heavens (when the Lord vouched for Job’s integrity); a. fr.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:14">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 12</cite> (ref. to the versions <he>חשכת</he>, Ps. l. c., and <he>חשרת</he> <cite ref="II Samuel 22:12">II Sam. XXII, 12</cite>) when the clouds are laden with the waters, <he>הן מַחְשִׁיכִין מן המים וכ׳</he> they receive a dark color from the waters, and afterwards they drop them as through a sieve.
